We evaluate the performance of MBR-BoN for two use cases. First, we evaluate the performance of MBR-BoN for decoding time alignment (Section 5.1). Then, we evaluate MBR-BoN as a sampling strategy to generate a preference learning dataset to be used for DPO (Section 5.2).
